$comment: Dashboard definitions are DATA validated against the metric catalogue (SPEC-007 §6.3, SPEC-000 §7.4; EP-008 M4(d)). A panel may only reference a registered metric family, a ratio panel MUST name the denominator series it is a ratio of, and an effectiveness ratio panel must render the interval's three ci values because §6.3 requires numerator, denominator and interval together. `sh scripts/metrics-catalogue-guard.sh` runs this validation, and a ratio panel without a denominator is the defect the schema check exists to catch.

dashboards.title: Removal effectiveness (VG-OBS-002)
dashboards.note: READ THIS BEFORE READING ANY PANEL: the ratio is independently verified removals divided by eligible confirmed matches, and it is never rendered without its denominator and its interval. A month with no eligible match has no ratio at all, not a zero.
